nodes.name: When fetching a dataset row
nodes.notes: Create a Data Table named 'munshiji-evals' (Data tables in the left sidebar), import workflows/munshiji-evals-dataset.csv into it - columns input_text, expected_tool, expected_contains, expected_language - then pick that table here. The table id is instance-specific, so the import cannot preselect it. The workflow runs once per row, in sequence.

nodes.name: Ask MunshiJi
nodes.notes: ChatIn's fields are merchant_id, text and language. The reply comes back as TurnResultOut: reply, language, tool_calls[].name and meta.latency_ms are everything the scorer needs.

nodes.name: Record metrics
nodes.notes: Parameters kept minimal on purpose. If your n8n renders this node differently, select operation 'Set Metrics' and metric 'Custom Metrics' in the UI and re-add the four numbers - the scoring node upstream already computed them all.
